DUMMY LIST OF WILDLIFE ENDANGERED WORLDWIDE----
As provided for by H.R. 4758. The following list is for demonstration purposes only and is not intended to indicate the actual classification of species as they may appear in official lists if the proposed legislation is enacted. Basis for this demonstration listing is as follows: (1) Endangered threatened with extinction is made up of species now appearing on both the Secretary's present list of endangered native list of fish and wildlife and the Secretary's present list of endangered foreign list of fish and wildlife; Endangered likely within the foreseeable future to become threatened with extinction is made up of the following: (a) all species and subspecies listed in the 1973 edition of Threatened Wildlife of the United States (published by the Bureau of Sport Fisheries and Wildlife) that do not appear on the present Secretary's list of endangered native fish and wildlife; (b) all species and subspecies in the Red Book of the International Union for the Conservation of Nature and Natural Resources that do not now appear on the Secretary's list of endangered foreign fish and wildlife; (c) a list of molluscs which are candidates for the Secretary's endangered native fish and wildlife. This demonstration list does not take into account those species and subspecies which may be moved from the present endangered lists to list of species endangered, likely within the foreseeable future to become threatened with extinction as defined under the proposed legislation.
